theorems.name: Submission.rsd_mw_measure_le_massOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → R.measure W ≤ T.massOn W
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
